Rae: Quick heads-up  the API reference for GET /orders/{order_id} shows example error payloads that include `code: 404` (integer) in one spot and `code: "NOT_FOUND"` (string) in another. Backend canonical error schema is `code`=string enum e.g. "NOT_FOUND" and `status`=HTTP int. This discrepancy causes confusion for SDK authors and the error mapping guides.

Omar: I saw that too when troubleshooting the Ruby SDK. Some generated examples were copied from old HTTP-centric docs. Do we want the canonical form to be `code` string and `status` numeric?

Rae: Yes. Confirmed with platform team: responses always include `status` numeric and `code` string enum. Request authors mistakenly put `code` as int in a couple of OpenAPI example blocks.

Helena: I'll take this. Plan: 1) Update OpenAPI example responses to show `{\"status\": 404, \"code\": \"NOT_FOUND\", \"message\": \"Order not found\"}` everywhere. 2) Update curl/python/js/Ruby SDK snippets to parse `code` as string and use enum checks (e.g., `if err.code == 'NOT_FOUND'`). 3) Add migration note and a tiny snippet for SDKs that previously expected numeric `code`.

Omar: For Ruby/Go SDK snippets, watch for generated example structs that currently have `Code int` in the sample. Change examples to `Code string` and show a safe coercion helper for older responses.

Helena: Good call. I'll include a short Go helper to coerce numeric codes to the canonical string: ```go
// normalize error code to string enum
func normalizeCode(v interface{}) string {
    switch t := v.(type) {
    case string: return t
    case int: return map[int]string{404: \"NOT_FOUND\", 401: \"UNAUTHORIZED\"}[t]
    default: return \"UNKNOWN_ERROR\"
    }
}
```

Rae: Nice. Also update the error mapping table in the API ref (the one that lists HTTP -> code enum)  it currently lists only HTTP status, not the canonical `code` value. Add both columns.

Omar: Can we add a docs-e2e lint that ensures every example error object contains both `status` (number) and `code` (string)? A simple JSON-shape check should catch regressions.

Helena: I'll add the lint and a test that searches for example blocks named `error` and validates the types. Also adding a small unit test that scans generated SDK examples to ensure the sample type for error code is string in the example.

docs-bot: Created issue #2378 and draft PR #3333: https://git.redwood/g/infra/docs/pulls/3333 (OpenAPI example fixes, SDK snippet updates, error mapping table, docs-e2e lint).

Rae: I'll review the PR. One more ask: please add a one-line note in the migration guide: "If your client previously used numeric `code`, switch to string enums and use the provided normalization helper when migrating."

Omar: Ping me when PR is ready, I'll run the SDK snippet preview. Thanks :thumbsup:

Helena: Will push changes this afternoon. ETA: 5 hrs.

Rae: Thanks team — this should reduce error-handling bugs in integrations.
